budget.note: Mechanical gate: runChecks fails with SFC1008 when the mandatory rule count exceeds firstVersionMax, and fails harder when it exceeds absoluteMax. The count includes every rule with severity mandatory, including budget rules themselves.

checkTypes.description: Each registered schema must compile under its declared dialect; an uncompilable schema fails with SFC1012.
No two registered schemas may share a $id; duplicates fail with SFC1003.
No two registered protocols may share the same name and version; duplicates fail with SFC1004.
Every $ref in registered schemas must resolve within the registered schema set; unresolved targets fail with SFC1005.
Every registered schema must declare a dialect from the supported set, consistent with its $schema URI; violations fail with SFC1006.
Every fixture expecting validity must validate against its target schema under its declared dialect and policy; mismatches fail with SFC1010.
Every fixture expecting invalidity must fail with exactly its declared stable error code; mismatches fail with SFC1010.
Every error code declared in fixture expectations must exist in the frozen error registry; unknown codes fail with SFC1009.
The mandatory rule count must stay within the first-version budget (and never exceed the absolute cap); excess fails with SFC1008.
